title: Aussichtsplattform Top of Tyrol Stubaier Gletscher
highlights: Gipfel-Aussichtsplattform auf 3210 Metern Seehöhe am Grossen Isidor
Blick auf über 109 Dreitausender der Stubaier und Ötztaler Alpen bis zu den Dolomiten
Bequem erreichbar mit der modernen 3S Eisgratbahn und der Schaufeljochbahn
kurzbeschreibung: The Top of Tyrol viewing platform extends cantilevered at 3,210 metres over the Stubaier Gletscher, offering views of over 100 three-thousand-metre peaks.
beschreibung:
Summit Experience at Over 3,200 Metres

The spectacular viewing platform Top of Tyrol is perched at an altitude of 3,210 metres on the Grosser Isidor at the Stubaier Gletscher. The bold, cantilevered architecture made of weather-resistant Corten steel extends nine metres over the abyss, delivering an incomparable high-alpine experience.

Panoramic Views Stretching to the Dolomites

From the platform, a breathtaking 360-degree panorama unfolds across more than 109 three-thousand-metre peaks, ranging from the Stubai Alps and the Ortler massif to the South Tyrolean Dolomites. The platform is also easily accessible for pedestrians and families via cable cars.
